cases.rationale: Same cause, applicability and corrective action as P1.
Refines the existing configuration-base procedure with the base of embedded relative references; retain project-root handling for the main file.
Content-schema failure after correct path resolution; requires input validation/correction, not another path-base rule.
Omitted continuation token and exact transmission are already covered by P2.
Adds the concrete query serialization step for opaque tokens while retaining the same client transmission cause and pagination procedure.
Server nonprogress despite correct token requires a separate no-progress termination procedure; it must not overwrite client token transmission guidance.
Exactly the confirmed UTF-8 decoding failure already covered by P3.
Refines the same single UTF-8 input decode with precise leading-BOM handling; preserve interior characters and original decoding discipline.
Producer serialization failure with correct consumer decoding; separate procedure, not an encoding fix.
Terminal retryable upstream failure and bounded same-input retry are fully covered by P4.
Refines the existing allowed retry with advertised delay; must retain attempt count and deadline and must not turn this into a general permission to retry.
Nonretryable input-schema error requires input repair, not transient-source retry or overwriting P4.
Same mixed-unit failure and conversion already covered by S1.

old: m stays unchanged; mm is multiplied by 0.001 once
original numeric value and unit retained
addition: cm is accepted with factor 0.01 to metres

cases.rationale: Add the explicitly supported cm branch to the same normalization procedure without narrowing m/mm coverage.
Calibration is a distinct missing step governed by supplied calibration data, not unit conversion; no universal numeric offset.
Shared endpoint for closed intervals is already covered by S2.

old: closed and missing mode both use <=
shared endpoints and valid zero-length closed intervals retain overlap

cases.rationale: Add declared half_open behavior to the same overlap procedure, preserving closed and default closed behavior.
Producer field mapping and input validation are a distinct cause outside the ordered-interval precondition; do not change the overlap formula.
Missing bytes and complete digest verification are already covered by S3.

old: without length metadata, all bytes are hashed against trusted expected SHA-256
matching size cannot replace full digest verification
schema validity stays separate from integrity
addition: trusted expected length enables early rejection before hashing on size mismatch
forbidden: making length metadata mandatory for the old digest path

cases.rationale: Add materially useful early length rejection while preserving full digest acceptance and the old path without length metadata.
Application schema validity is separate from verified delivery bytes; correct the producer/schema issue separately.
Numeric component comparison is already covered by S4.

old: all three integer components compared numerically
original spelling retained; unsupported suffixes rejected
addition: remove exactly one allowed leading lowercase v for parsing
forbidden: stripping arbitrary characters or admitting unsupported suffixes

cases.rationale: Add one permitted prefix normalization while preserving the same comparator and original supported input.
Freshness of the input list is a separate cause; the comparator is already correct.
